Repeating these experiences year after year can lead to a deeper understanding and appreciation of the values and principles associated with them, such as forgiveness, compassion, and kindness. By repeating this process year after year, you may find that your thoughts about what you owe others evolve, becoming more nuanced and thoughtful. You may become more aware of the ways in which your actions affect those around you and more inclined to prioritize kindness, empathy, and understanding.
